* Rail-to-rail-input two-stage Miller OTA, class-A output stage
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* bias: IREF into IBIAS sets diode NMOS (10 uA); PB is PMOS diode bias
XMBN0 IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMBN1 PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=15 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMBP0 PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=10 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMTN TAILN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=40 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMTP TAILP PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=35 L=1 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS input pair with PMOS mirror load
XMN1 NA VINN TAILN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMN2 V1 VINP TAILN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPD1 NA NA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMPO1 V1 NA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS input pair with NMOS mirror load
XMP1 PA VINN TAILP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMP2 V1 VINP TAILP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMND PA PA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNO V1 PA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=10 L=1 nf=1 m=1
* second stage and output current source
XMO VOUT V1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=40 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XMPL VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 nf=1 m=1
CC V1 VOUT 6p
.ends DUT
